<section class="v-section v-method" id="method" aria-labelledby="method-title">
  <header class="v-section-heading"><h2 id="method-title">Anatomy and motion, modeled together</h2><p>Joint 3D+t synthesis in a compact latent space.</p></header>
  <div class="v-method-layout">
    <figure class="v-framework"><a class="v-figure-link" href="../../assets/paper-figures/cardiodit-figure-1-framework.jpg" aria-label="View full CardioDiT framework figure"><img src="../../assets/paper-figures/cardiodit-figure-1-framework.jpg" width="1358" height="930" loading="lazy" alt="CardioDiT framework: encode 2D plus time slices, stack their latents into a full 4D volume, jointly denoise with a diffusion transformer, then decode."><i class="bi bi-arrows-fullscreen" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><figcaption><span>CardioDiT framework · Figure 1</span><a href="../../assets/paper-figures/cardiodit-figure-1-framework.jpg">View full figure <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></figcaption></figure>
    <ol class="v-method-steps">
      <li><span class="v-step-number" aria-hidden="true">01</span><h3>Encode the sequence</h3><p>Compress each 2D+t slice with a spatiotemporal autoencoder.</p></li>
      <li><span class="v-step-number" aria-hidden="true">02</span><h3>Model space and time</h3><p>Model stacked slice latents jointly with a 4D diffusion transformer.</p></li>
      <li><span class="v-step-number" aria-hidden="true">03</span><h3>Decode the motion</h3><p>Decode the latent volume into a complete cardiac cine MRI sequence.</p></li>
    </ol>
  </div>
  <p class="v-method-summary">CardioDiT learns anatomy and cardiac motion jointly across a complete 3D+t volume. Four-dimensional patches preserve relationships across space and time.</p>
  <a class="v-next" href="#results">See the evidence <i class="bi bi-arrow-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>
</section>

<section class="v-section v-results" id="results" aria-labelledby="results-title">
  <header class="v-section-heading"><h2 id="results-title">Generation quality, measured</h2><p>Results from the MICCAI 2026 paper · 50 generated volumes per model.</p></header>
  <div class="v-results-body"><div class="v-tables"><div class="v-table-scroll" role="region" aria-label="Public cohorts generation results" tabindex="0"><table><caption><strong>Public cohorts</strong><span>ACDC + M&amp;Ms-2 · CineMA features</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Model</th><th scope="col">FID ↓</th><th scope="col">Precision ↑</th><th scope="col">Recall ↑</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th scope="row">2D+t LDM</th><td>100.1</td><td>0.89</td><td>0.17</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">3D+t U-Net</th><td>221.5</td><td>0.59</td><td>0.64</td></tr><tr class="v-result-highlight"><th scope="row">CardioDiT</th><td><strong>71.9</strong></td><td>0.97</td><td>0.70</td></tr></tbody></table></div><div class="v-table-scroll" role="region" aria-label="Private cohort generation results" tabindex="0"><table><caption><strong>Private cohort</strong><span>CineMA features</span></caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Model</th><th scope="col">FID ↓</th><th scope="col">Precision ↑</th><th scope="col">Recall ↑</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th scope="row">2D+t LDM</th><td>32.9</td><td>0.58</td><td>0.36</td></tr><tr><th scope="row">3D+t U-Net</th><td>51.3</td><td>0.43</td><td>0.23</td></tr><tr class="v-result-highlight"><th scope="row">CardioDiT</th><td><strong>21.2</strong></td><td>0.82</td><td>0.54</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div>
    <p class="v-caption v-fid-note">Each cohort uses its real validation set as reference.</p>
    <div class="v-control-results c-function-results"><h3>Cardiac function across the cycle</h3><p>Ejection fraction · mean ± standard deviation (%)</p><div class="v-dice-groups">
      <div class="v-dice-group"><h4>Public cohorts</h4><dl><div><dt>CardioDiT</dt><dd>49.3 ± 15.1</dd></div><div><dt>Real</dt><dd>47.6 ± 17.1</dd></div></dl></div>
      <div class="v-dice-group"><h4>Private cohort</h4><dl><div><dt>CardioDiT</dt><dd>42.3 ± 6.3</dd></div><div><dt>Real</dt><dd>44.6 ± 7.3</dd></div></dl></div>
    </div></div>
    <div class="v-results-scope"><p class="v-caption">Fixed spatial sizes and 32-frame standardization. Full structural and function analyses are reported in the paper.</p><a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2603.25194v1#S2.T1">Full results and ablations <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></div>
  </div><a class="v-next" href="#development">Ongoing research <i class="bi bi-arrow-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>
</section>

    <ol class="v-method-steps">

      <li><span class="v-step-number" aria-hidden="true">02</span><h3>Native temporal lengths</h3><p>Development toward sequences with variable frame counts.</p></li>
